description: This file contains the server-side code for managing a Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) exam page in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database based on the selected course, displaying questions, processing user answers, computing the score, and controlling exam timing.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page, managing question loading, answer processing, and timing functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page by loading questions from the database based on the selected course and setting up the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, stores the result in the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the exam timer countdown, updating the display and ending the exam when time expires.
